review: Labeled final encoded sheet, ordered loop frames and independent blind axes
scope: Sixteen newly generated hornless look frames; cardinals confirmed by three blind reviewers.

directions.reason: Centered raised muzzle and both blue eyes aim high, with the chin exposed.
Nose and face yaw screen-right while the snout is raised and the eyes aim high.
Rightward nose and raised eye line express the upper-right diagonal.
Rightward snout is slightly raised relative to 090; its upward component is subtle.
Nose, face and blue eye surfaces point screen-right at near-level pitch.
Right-facing head lowers relative to 090; vertical direction is subtle and two blind reviewers called it ambiguous.
Nose points screen-right and down while the head visibly bows and the eyes aim lower.
Deeply lowered snout keeps a rightward yaw, approaching the down cardinal.
Frontal centered nose bows toward the chest with both eye surfaces aimed low.
Bowed head begins its screen-left yaw; two blind reviewers saw down-left, one saw straight down.
Muzzle and eye surfaces point screen-left below the neutral eye line.
Left-facing muzzle stays slightly lowered; the down component is restrained.
Muzzle and blue eye surfaces aim screen-left with approximately horizontal pitch.
Head and nose turn left and lift slightly; both axes were recognized by all reviewers.
Raised snout and eye surfaces aim diagonally toward the upper-left.
Chin rises strongly while nose and eyes retain a leftward aim approaching the up cardinal.

continuity_review: 157.5->180 and 337.5->000 have larger local pixel differences; the first joins distinct head pitches and a 1.24 visible-area ratio. No clipping, alpha hole, wrong quadrant, reversal or blocking registration snap observed in native-size ordered frames. Retained as reviewed warnings.
